polaris: RP镍酸盐中 DW 层解耦是否是超导前体还是超导抑制器？
framework: 计算机科学：分布式系统共识、网络分区与纠错码阈值
findings: 把三层 La4Ni3O10 视为需要达成全局相位共识的分布式节点。静态 DW 的核心作用不是提供胶水，而是在 Ni dz2 层间通道上制造网络分区，使每个 Ni-O 层可以局部有序但无法形成三维相位刚性。因此静态 DW 是 bulk superconductivity 的抑制器；只有临界、短寿命、未冻结 dz2 占据的 DW 涨落，才可能作为前体。关键判据不是 DW 是否存在，而是 DW 是否降低层间互信息/有效层间传输谱权。
math_object: 分布式共识中的 network partition 与 quorum certificate；深化到纠错码阈值：只有跨层校验边密度超过阈值时，局部相位错误才可被全局纠正。物理映射为层间相干参数 Lambda = hbar*t_perp_eff/(k_B*T + hbar*Gamma_DW)，当 Lambda 小于临界阈值 Lambda_c 时，系统可有局部配对涨落但不能建立 bulk 三维超导。
strangest_prediction: 在 La4Ni3O10 中，如果用泵浦、压力或应变选择性恢复 dz2 层间通道，即使 DW 振幅尚未完全消失，也应先出现 c-axis 低频光谱权重恢复；bulk Tc 或 Meissner 体积分数随后才上升。反过来，若只熔化 DW 峰但 rho_c/rho_ab 仍大于约 10^3，则不会出现真正 bulk superconductivity，只会出现短寿命或二维样的配对迹象。
a_objection: 保守凝聚态框架会反对：DW 和 superconductivity 相邻已经说明 DW 涨落可能是 pairing glue，不能把静态 DW 直接判作抑制器。我的回应是：glue 与 global phase quorum 是两个不同层级；前者可局部增强配对，后者决定是否形成 bulk superconductivity。PRL 2026 的 rho_c/rho_ab 从约 70 增至约 2600 正好显示静态 DW 破坏的是 quorum 通道。
failed_jumps: 音乐理论/对位法：能类比多声部独立与和声闭合，但无法给出可操作的物理阈值或可量化观测量，放弃。
地质学/断层封闭：能类比层间滑移和渗流阻断，但缺少与 dz2 轨道占据、低频光谱权重直接同构的数学对象，暂不采用。
next_plan: Round 2 若继续，应比较三类扰动的排序：c-axis pressure、in-plane pressure、ultrafast DW melting。若我的框架正确，增强层间通道的扰动应优先提升 superconducting volume fraction，而不必先完全消除 DW 振幅。
literature_needed: La4Ni3O10 pressure anisotropic transport rho_c/rho_ab superconductivity; polarized infrared La4Ni3O10 pressure DW; pump probe La4Ni3O10 density wave melt c-axis conductivity; uniaxial strain Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate superconductivity interlayer coherence

deepening.level_1_isomorphism: 分布式系统中，网络分区允许每个 partition 内部达成局部一致，但禁止全局共识。映射到 RP 镍酸盐：DW 可以允许单层或双层内局部配对/磁电有序，却通过 dz2 占据重分布阻断跨层相位一致。
deepening.level_2_deeper_structure: 纠错码阈值提供更深层结构：超导相位刚性像跨层校验边组成的码距。DW 若移除 dz2 边，相当于降低校验矩阵秩；当最小跨层校验边密度低于阈值，局部相位错误无法被纠正，bulk stiffness 消失。
deepening.translation_failure_boundary: 该映射不声称 superconductivity 是计算过程；只借用 partition/quorum/threshold 的数学结构。它不能预测 pairing symmetry，只预测层间相干、各向异性和 bulk 体积分数之间的方向关系。

predictions.system: La4Ni3O10 single crystal or epitaxial film near ambient-pressure DW transition
predictions.observable: rho_c/rho_ab and low-frequency c-axis optical spectral weight integrated below 40 meV
predictions.expected: Entering the static DW phase should increase rho_c/rho_ab from order 10^2 toward order 10^3 while suppressing c-axis Drude/small-polaron spectral weight. If superconductivity later appears under pressure while rho_c/rho_ab remains above 10^3, it should be non-bulk or filamentary; bulk Meissner fraction should require anisotropy reduced below roughly 10^2-10^3.
predictions.test_type: existing PRL 2026 data plus pressure transport/optics cross-check

predictions.system: Pressurized La4Ni3O10 across the DW-collapse/superconductivity boundary reported in Nat Commun 2025
predictions.observable: pressure derivative sequence of DW amplitude, rho_c/rho_ab, and Tc or superconducting volume fraction
predictions.expected: The first robust superconducting signal should track recovery of interlayer coherence more tightly than disappearance of the DW amplitude. A pressure point with reduced anisotropy but residual DW order can still superconduct; a pressure point with collapsed DW peak but unresolved high anisotropy should not show bulk superconductivity.
predictions.test_type: compare pressure-dependent transport, ultrafast DW amplitude, and magnetic shielding

predictions.system: Ultrafast pump-probe La4Ni3O10 below T_DW with probe polarization along c and ab
predictions.observable: time-resolved Delta sigma_c(omega<40 meV), Delta sigma_ab, and out-of-plane phonon splitting
predictions.expected: A nonthermal DW melt should produce a positive Delta sigma_c before any long-lived superconducting stiffness signal. The ratio Delta sigma_c/Delta sigma_ab should be strongly positive and peak while out-of-plane phonon splitting collapses. If only Delta sigma_ab grows and sigma_c remains suppressed, the pump has created local precursor correlations but not a superconducting route.

predictions.system: La4Ni3O10 under uniaxial c-axis compression compared with mostly in-plane strain at fixed carrier count
predictions.observable: change in rho_c/rho_ab, T_DW, and superconducting onset/volume fraction
predictions.expected: c-axis compression should enhance superconducting signatures more efficiently than in-plane strain if it restores dz2-mediated quorum edges. The decisive sign is d(rho_c/rho_ab)/d epsilon_c < 0 accompanied by increased superconducting volume fraction even when T_DW changes weakly.

inspector_check.formula: Lambda = hbar*t_perp_eff/(k_B*T + hbar*Gamma_DW), dimensionless. A bulk coherence threshold is Lambda > Lambda_c.
inspector_check.direction: Static DW suppresses bulk superconductivity when it lowers t_perp_eff or raises Gamma_DW enough to push Lambda below threshold; fluctuating DW can be precursor only if it does not reduce Lambda.
inspector_check.data: PRL 136, 216501 (2026): La4Ni3O10 DW phase suppresses c-axis conductivity and raises rho_c/rho_ab from about 70 to about 2600; Nat Commun 2025 reports DW collapse with superconductivity emergence under pressure.
inspector_check.assumptions: rho_c/rho_ab and c-axis low-frequency spectral weight are adequate proxies for interlayer coherence; bulk superconductivity in RP nickelates requires nonzero 3D phase stiffness; pressure does not introduce a completely unrelated superconducting channel.

claims.statement: Static DW order in La4Ni3O10 is a superconductivity suppressor at the bulk-coherence level because it partitions the trilayer network by reducing dz2-mediated interlayer coherence.

claims.statement: The experimental discriminator is not DW amplitude alone but the ordering of three events: c-axis spectral-weight recovery, DW-amplitude collapse, and superconducting stiffness onset.
